phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, opponent ground posture (Marine/Reaper) or unknown, own Zergling/Queen, economy heavy.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent shows air presence or tech switch, or when you reach a new tech tier.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and expansions while building Zerglings and Queens; maintain scouting to detect early aggression.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army, increase economy and expansions, continue tech, maintain defense.
phase_policies.title: Early Ground Macro with Expansion
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to expansions without maintaining army production and scouting for early pressure.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early midgame, opponent ground posture (Marine/Reaper/Hellion), own Zergling/Queen, tech moderate.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance tech upgrades with army production; expand cautiously and keep scouting for tech switches.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground, increase economy, continue expansions and production, increase tech.
phase_policies.title: Early Midgame Ground Tech Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect army size while teching; ensure scouting to anticipate attacks.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, opponent ground posture (SiegeTank/Marine/Reaper/Marauder), own Zergling/Hydralisk/Queen/Overseer.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain a strong ground army with Hydralisks, continue expanding, and tech towards upgrades while scouting.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army, increase economy, continue expansions and production, increase tech.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground vs Ground with Hydralisks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to tech without maintaining army size; keep scouting for air transitions.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late midgame, opponent ground posture (SiegeTank/Marine/Reaper/Hellion), own Zergling/Queen, both heavy economy and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prepare for large engagements by maintaining economy and tech, while keeping a strong ground army and scouting.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army, increase economy, continue expansions and production, increase tech.
phase_policies.title: Late Midgame Ground vs Ground
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defense while teching; ensure scouting to avoid being caught off guard.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
